content:
Amazon’s early Black Friday sale is in full swing and, while we aren’t expecting it to kick into overdrive until next week, it unexpectedly just delivered the lowest price ever on the latest Apple Watch Series 12, starting at $329 shipped. That’s the best deal we have tracked to date at $70 off the list on several different configurations, including the high-end Pearl White ceramic models.

Amazon is now delivering Apple’s latest and greatest Series 12 wearables at the lowest price ever, with a collection of configurations at $70 off the list price.

You’ll find the most popular base 42mm and 46mm GPS-only models sitting down at $329 and $379, respectively, to deliver the best deals we have tracked to date. Those deals also sit alongside the always-connected cell models with the same $70 discount starting from $429:

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 42mm: $329 (Reg. $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $379 (Reg. $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm: $429 (Reg. $499)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $479 (Reg. $549)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Titanium: $629 (Reg. $699)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 42mm Titanium w/ Milanese Loop: $679 (Reg. $749)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm Titanium w/ Milanese Loop: $729 (Reg. $799)

You’ll find Apple’s luxurious new ceramic configuration at the best prices we have tracked with the same $70 discounts:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 Ceramic $829 (Reg. $899) – Pearl White
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 12 Ceramic $829 (Reg. $899) – Night Blue
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 12 Ceramic $879 (Reg. $949) – Night Blue

For historical reference, we are looking at the best deals ever tracked, undercutting the previous fall Prime Day discounts at $50 off on just about all models, to deliver Amazon all-time low pricing and a perfect chance to get one under the tree at the lowest price to date.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249) – Now even lower
  • 1-pack AirTag 2 $23 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • 4-pack AirTag 2 $70 (Reg. $99) – Matching all-time low
  • Apple HomeView $289 (Reg. $299)
  • 2026 Apple Polishing Cloth $9 – Back in-stock
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air from $1,099 ($200 off)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,349 (Reg. $1,599) – $250 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,549 (Reg. $1,799) – $250 off
